TRAINING REPORT — PDPM IIITDM JABALPUR INTERNSHIP TRAINING REPORT ON MACHINE LEARNING & COMPUTER VISION Summary Of Work Completed Duration: 6 Weeks AT PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing, Jabalpur (PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur) Submitted By: Astha Singh Under the Guidance of: Dr Akshay Pandey Assistant Professor Department of Computer Science & Engineering PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur ___________________________ Signature Internship Training Report | PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur 1

1. Executive Summary & Objectives This professional engineering training report presents the systemic implementation, algorithmic validations, and core architectures completed during a six-week technical tenure at PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur. The core objective of this engagement was to study Machine Learning fundamentals, implement computer vision concepts, explore foundational cloud systems, and design functional distributed networks to solve real-world automation challenges.

The progression of development covered key core engineering modules: Predictive Modeling & Statistical Foundations: Architectural implementation of scaling metrics and multidimensional validation structures across standard statistical classifiers. Deep Learning Architecture & High-Performance Pipelines: Convolutional feature extraction mapping coupled with modern real-time streaming optimizations via NVIDIA DeepStream. Google Earth Engine: Acquiring basic conceptual knowledge of the interface ecosystem and executing simple test scripts to view output data maps. Distributed Systems Network Layer: Constructing low-latency synchronization channels with Python Flask RESTful APIs for automated data telemetry and interactive monitoring dashboards. Industrial Capstone System: Formulating a custom computer vision pipeline for inventory tracking and warehouse safety audits via a Grain Spillage Detection System. 2.

Industrial Capstone System: Formulating a custom computer vision pipeline for inventory tracking and warehouse safety audits via a Grain Spillage Detection System. 2. Technical Chronicles & Milestones Statistical Foundations & Classical Machine Learning Pipelines The training began with constructing exploratory pipelines, data scaling layers, and standard cross-validation routines to evaluate classification models. Data Processing Layers: Conducted Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) alongside missing value handling and variance-normalizing Feature Scaling. Enforced explicit train-test dataset separation rules to eliminate data leakage. Classifier Benchmarking: Engineered comparative testing models using major algorithms: Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Trees, and Random Forests.

Multi-Metric Evaluation: Structured comprehensive diagnostic parameters including Precision, Recall, F1- Score, ROC-AUC Curve performance, and explicit Confusion Matrices. Validation Structures: Executed 10-fold Cross-Validation across multiple distinct randomized train-test splits to guarantee generalized data behavior. Utilized Hyperparameter Optimization and feature importance metrics on Random Forest classifiers. Deep Learning Fundamentals & NVIDIA DeepStream Architectures Shifted evaluation metrics into layered spatial extraction configurations, focusing on real-time computer vision stream structures.

Deep Learning Fundamentals & NVIDIA DeepStream Architectures Shifted evaluation metrics into layered spatial extraction configurations, focusing on real-time computer vision stream structures. CNN Deep Dive: Mastered layer configurations within Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), evaluating mathematical functions behind 2D Convolutions, Max/Average Pooling filters, ReLU non-linear activations, and fully-connected dense layers. • • • • • • • • • • Internship Training Report | PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur 2

NVIDIA DeepStream Framework: Studied the pipeline mechanics of NVIDIA DeepStream for high-throughput stream execution, real-time object detection processing, tracking, and latency optimization. Operational Use Cases: Evaluated the integration criteria of deep neural models across high-impact commercial scenarios including modern intelligent surveillance systems, autonomous vehicle navigation, and complex pattern recognition.

Google Earth Engine An introductory study was conducted to understand the scope, purpose, and operational interface environments of cloud-based spatial platforms. Foundational Scope: Studied only the basic introductory concepts of Google Earth Engine (GEE), evaluating what the platform is and where it is applied in environmental mapping. Satellite Basics: Explored elementary definitions regarding types of observation satellites, tracking intervals, and general imaging classification structures. Basic Script Execution: Executed a basic JavaScript code sample within the platform's editor interface to load initial data collections and view the basic processed output map. Distributed Full-Stack System Integration & Real-Time Dashboards Designed and optimized a distributed client-server data network architecture dedicated to data passing, telemetry logging, and continuous visual logging.

Flask Communication Engine: Programmed a local client-side telemetry system driven by a Flask REST API backend to receive object detection responses from deep learning instances. Arranged continuous cross- machine local area network (LAN) data routes mapping across system IP addresses. Dynamic Interface Layout: Structured an interactive web dashboard explicitly managed to map detection payloads into clear logs containing tracking labels, model confidence scores, and strict Unix timestamps. Latency Control Optimization: Overcame data streaming choke points by creating an automated auto-refresh polling model on the interface wrapper, reducing data synchronization delays while preventing full browser reload drops. Verification Cycles: Validated network reliability by testing operations under various simulation profiles, ensuring consistent sync streams without missing metadata fields.

Verification Cycles: Validated network reliability by testing operations under various simulation profiles, ensuring consistent sync streams without missing metadata fields. Capstone Project — Industrial Grain Spillage Detection System Applied cumulative technical competencies into an agricultural warehouse automation tracking product designed for grain spillage detection and safety monitoring. Project Scoping & Definition: Established the baseline operational requirements, detection speed boundaries, and targeted evaluation criteria for the grain spillage tracking system. Dataset Curation: Organized relevant sample image data repositories, incorporating the structured Kaggle Warehouse Dataset with custom workplace asset captures.

Dataset Curation: Organized relevant sample image data repositories, incorporating the structured Kaggle Warehouse Dataset with custom workplace asset captures. Annotation & Masking Workflows: Investigated segmentation methodologies by comparing manual boundary curation in the Computer Vision Annotation Tool (CVAT) with automated masking layers via Meta's Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2), consolidating annotations inside Roboflow. Augmentation & Dataset Preparation: Audited imagery labels to resolve structural inconsistencies, split datasets into rigid training and validation paths, and applied luminance and geometric transformations.

Model Training & Parameter Configuration: Configured training hyperparameters, anchor boundaries, and structural optimization models while monitoring error rate shifts and learning metrics. • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Internship Training Report | PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur 3

Validation Testing & Pipeline Documentation: Tested final model weights against raw, unseen image assets and live streaming media to build confusion matrices, evaluate edge bottlenecks, and fully document the pipeline layout. 3. Skills Gained Data Science & Predictive Engineering Conducting advanced Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and missing dataset imputation pipelines. Applying variance-normalizing feature transformation and scaling techniques to raw feature spaces. Analytical Model Evaluation & Validation Enforcing strict train-test segmentation structures to entirely prevent systemic training data leakage. Executing robust 10-fold cross-validation matrices to evaluate model performance across multiple variations.

Executing robust 10-fold cross-validation matrices to evaluate model performance across multiple variations. Parsing diagnostic multi-class statistical parameters including Precision-Recall, F1-Score balancing, and ROC- AUC boundaries. Deep Learning & Core Computer Vision Designing, structuring, and optimizing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) feature extraction layer chains. Structuring custom training workflows from raw bounding boxes up to production execution weights. Handling pixel data pre-processing, structural boundary normalization, and cross-domain data adaptation models. Basic Interface Environments Navigating basic introductory tools in the Google Earth Engine JavaScript code interface to run basic script configurations. Conclusion In conclusion, this training tenure successfully achieved its key milestones by bridging theoretical data science methodologies with functional full-stack engineering deployments. The work executed validates the systematic development of classical predictive machine learning pipelines using Scikit-Learn alongside advanced 10-fold cross-validation metrics. It successfully confirms the design of deep convolutional network structures for spatial feature mapping coupled with robust client-server networking layers driven by Flask RESTful APIs over local area channels. The final realization of the Grain Spillage Detection capstone system demonstrates the immense value of combining automated computer vision models with live telemetry logging frameworks.
